analysis.reason: 3일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 시도 중이나 여전히 중립 구간. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세이나 여전히 음수 구간. 거래량 위축으로 추세 전환 신뢰도 낮음. 5일 변동률 +6.85%로 반등했으나 2일 전 -8.79% 하락분을 완전히 회복하지 못함. 1,678,000원 스윙 지지선과 1,995,000원 스윙 저항선 사이 횡보 구간 지속.
analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive days of wait-and-see. RSI attempts to exit oversold but remains neutral. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays negative. Low trading volume reduces conviction for trend change. Today's +6.85% rebound did not fully recover the -8.79% drop from 2 days prior. Price remains within the 1,678,000 support and 1,995,000 resistance range.

analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 trading sessions. Today's RSI rise from 33.2 to 45.0 and MACD histogram improvement from -60608.8952 to -7629.5485 slightly increased the buy score from 4 to 5, but the wait-and-see approach persists due to subdued volume and MACD remaining in negative territory.
